note: RFC 9687 Section 4.3 Event 29 changes state to Idle. Re-read SendHoldExpiryRunsTheEvent29ActionList and NoSendHoldExpiryLeavesTheSessionIntact: the positive advances exactly SendHoldTime, now joins exact ErrSendHoldTimerExpired and asserts StateIdle; the negative stops one nanosecond short, rejects terminal Run completion and requires StateEstablished. The fixture establishes through real OPEN/KEEPALIVE processing and chooses a deadline preceding every other session timer. sendHoldTimerExpired delivers the event to fsm's Established HoldTimerExpires handler, whose exact transition is Idle. A missing, wrong or premature transition violates a distinct state assertion; Run completion alone does not stand in for that transition. No native execution claimed.
